title: Control How Your GPU Shares Work with Green Contexts
text:

GPU applications increasingly consist of multiple independent components running at the same time within a single process: a latency-sensitive operator alongside a throughput-oriented background kernel; a data preprocessing stage alongside model inference; or multiple stages of a processing workflow sharing a single GPU. Controlling how GPU resources are shared between them remains difficult.
